snippet.title: LABYRAINTH Gameplay Trailer - first version
snippet.description:
LABYRAINTH Steam Page: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672600/LabyrAInth/

LABYRAINTH is a single-player, first person shooter, action-adventure game, set in a sci-fi world made of labyrinths. Fight your way out of a huge number of different dynamically created labyrinths. Your enemy is an omniscient AI who watches everything you do and sets traps and enemies to slow you down and kill you. Time is your second enemy, you will not have much time to solve any labyrinth and as you progress through the game it will become even harder.
Activate powers, find weapon components to attach to your main weapon, personalize your weapon and upgrade it between levels to increase the chances of winning.
LabyrAInth features 5 game modes:
Story: advance through a series of labyrinths and find the exit of all of them to beat the AI.
Infinite: compete against other players on online leaderboards on an infinite number of labyrinths of ever-increasing difficulty
Ranked: compete against other players on online leaderboards on a fixed number and configuration of labyrinths that changes every week.
Survival: fight hordes of aliens coming to kill you, hide, defend, upgrade your weapon and fight! How long will you survive in the labyrinth?
Creative: create your own labyrinth, make it big or make it small but super tough, fill it with enemies and traps and then play in it! Then share it with your firends!
LABYRAINTH will relrease on 31 of October 2025 for PC Windows and Mac platforms.
Future release for VR devices and mobile devices is already planned. 

Can you beat the Labyrinth?
